name: Ken Howery

source.title: File:United States Ambassador to Denmark Kenneth Alan Howery.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

lean.basis: Appointed U.S. ambassador by Trump twice (Sweden 2019–2021, Denmark since 2025). No party office or other partisan record found, so Center-right rather than Right.

sources.title: U.S. State Department: Kenneth A. Howery

summary: Ken Howery co-founded Confinity/PayPal in 1998 and was its first chief financial officer, then co-founded Founders Fund with Peter Thiel and Luke Nosek in 2005. Trump appointed him ambassador to Sweden (2019–2021) and, in his second term, ambassador to Denmark, where he has been involved in talks over Greenland.
